name: CD Skip
description: Scratched-CD / failing Discman tracking-skip & CIRC read-error burst looper (UNLATCH=retro grab, LATCH=auto transient) with laser-hunt, stereo desync, and clean Butterworth LPF.

params.name: Slice
params.explanation: Base CD sector slice length on an exponential curve (13.3 ms = 1 CD frame to 2,000 ms).

params.name: Skip
params.explanation: Tracking jump & laser-hunt depth (0 = locked sector, 100 = random 1x..1/8x subdivisions & read-head slip).

params.name: Error
params.explanation: CIRC / Reed-Solomon error concealment burst rate (C2 mute dropouts, ZOH sample-freeze chirps, PCM bit-error crackle).

params.name: RndMd
params.explanation: When tracking jumps, laser slip, and error bursts re-roll: on STOMP, every SLICE wrap, or BOTH.

params.name: Click
params.explanation: Sector splice hardness (100 = razor-sharp 0-sample CD jump, 0 = smooth 3.6 ms anti-click fade).

params.name: Width
params.explanation: Stereo desync (independent L/R micro-offset and occasional single-channel C2 dropouts).

params.name: LPF
params.explanation: Clean undriven 2-pole Butterworth LPF cutoff (500 Hz to 16 kHz; 100 = completely open/bypassed).

params.name: Level
params.explanation: Wet output level (80 is unity at nominal MS-70CDR+ bus level).

params.name: Mix
params.explanation: Dry vs. wet crossfade when active (0..100%).

params.name: ON/OFF
params.explanation: LATCH: normal toggle. UNLATCH: momentary while held.
